text:
eva: heads-up — canary v2.9.4 to dedicated pool (reserved) showing 5xx spike on the /generate route, started ~4m ago :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: rollout: v2.9.4 -> 15% dedicated-usw. metrics: 5xx=3.2% (baseline 0.05%), p95=430ms. autorevert rule: 5xx>1.0% sustained 3m. breach detected 2m ago.
omar: oom or model-side error? logs show OOM traces on worker-2 around the same window.
eva: interesting — this pool uses a different mem allocator flag we enabled in the last build. could be related.
chi: i don't see kernel diffs but there is a new allocator toggle: `--use-fast-alloc=true` in the build. recommend pin+hold and try reverting that flag on the two affected nodes before rollback.
deploy-bot: autopilot scheduled auto-revert in ~1m unless held.
pm-court: if autopilot reverts, ops should prep a short customer blurb. prefer manual triage so we can attempt low-risk mitigations.
ops-lia: manual hold preferred. pin traffic at 15% and patch allocator flag on the two affected hosts in-place. will coordinate with infra. tag @support for watch.
eva: pinned at 15% and applied manual hold. deploy-bot: traffic pinned by eva; autopilot rollback suppressed.
ops-lia: rolling a config flip on worker-2 and worker-5 to set `use-fast-alloc=false` now. small restarts expected for those processes.
sre-bot: metric update: worker-2 5xx dropped from 4.4% -> 0.2% after flag flip; pool 5xx now 0.9%. p95 stable.
omar: nice, quick win. keep pinned and monitor for 10m. if 5xx creeps above 1.5% sustained 4m we'll revert the version to v2.9.3 (build 20260610.7).
chi: logging decision: reason=canary-5xx-spike, action=manual-hold+config-flip, rollback-if=4m sustained 5xx>1.5%, rollback-target=v2.9.3, comms=prep blurb queued.
pm-court: customer blurb draft: "We paused the canary for v2.9.4 after a subset of requests returned elevated server errors. We applied a mitigation and are monitoring. No broad customer impact observed." ok to send on ops thumbs up? :email:
ops-lia: send now, tagging support for 24/7 watch. created incident-#4587 for postmortem tracking.
eva: thanks — i'll update release notes to mark rollforward blocked until postmortem.
deploy-bot: note: autorevert suppressed by manual hold. suggested rollback window remains available if threshold met.
sre-bot: 10m monitor note: pool 5xx trending down, current 0.6%. keeping hold for 10m as planned.
eva: updating here in 10m or sooner if it regresses. good catch everyone. :thumbsup:
